data.cultural_impact: The name Arlan has noble and mythical overtones due to its roots in Old High German language, representing the power and dominance associated with rulers and eagles. Historically, the name has been carried by important figures in medieval storytelling and is thus deeply ingrained within European folklore.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Arlan represents the warrior spirit within all of us: the courageous fighter who conquers personal and spiritual challenges, the fearless defender of our beliefs, and the triumphant ruler over our thoughts and emotions. As such, it can serve as a powerful inspiration for individuals seeking to manifest strength and determination in their lives.
